Bill.BriefDescription: Extending the age for service in the Washington state guard.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to extending the age for service in the Washingtonstate guard; and amending RCW 38.16.015.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 38.16.015 and 1989 c 19 s 30 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The period of enlistment in the Washington state guard shall beset by regulation by the adjutant general((: PROVIDED, That)).However, no original enlistment may be consummated unless the termthereof can be completed before the applicant attains the age of sixtyfour. (2) Notwithstanding subsection (1) of this section, the adjutantgeneral may extend the service age upon request by an active member ofthe Washington state guard if the member proves satisfactory completionof physical and mental requirements and the member lives in an areawhere there is a specific military need for the state guard services.Extensions under this subsection have a oneyear duration and may berenewed.
